deploymentMechanism: One production Git push after local verification; no CLI/API deployment or prebuilt upload.
postReleaseScope: Exactly one read-only GET of the new article per site; no hosted browser, accessibility, regression, crawl, screenshot or load test.
recordStorage: Saved locally after release. Not pushed, to avoid triggering another production deployment.

localVerification.productionBuild: passed in isolated checkout without production credentials
localVerification.blogBrowser: passed for old/new posts, mobile/desktop, no-JS, workspace entry and 404
excluded: AI evaluation execution and generated results
